title: Electric field magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly states the final answer for part (1) as E = √2 mg / q, derived from the initial force equilibrium condition.

title: Time in E2 field
description: Essential: Correctly states the final answer for part (2) as t = √(2l/g), derived from analyzing the motion in the second quadrant.

title: Coordinates of point A
description: Essential: Correctly states the final answer for part (3) as A = (2(√2 - 1)l, 2(√2 - 1)l), derived from kinematics in the first quadrant.

title: Kinetic energy at D
description: Essential: Correctly states the final answer for part (4) as EkD = 2√2 mgl, derived from applying the work-energy theorem across all regions.

title: Initial force equilibrium
description: Important: Applies force balance in the second quadrant to relate electric force, gravity, and tension (before cutting) to find E.

title: Motion analysis in E1
description: Important: Correctly determines the acceleration in the first quadrant (E2 field) as a = (qE + mg)/m and analyzes the projectile-like motion to find conditions at point A.

title: Work-energy application
description: Important: Applies the work-energy theorem correctly, summing work done by electric forces and gravity from start to point D.

title: Geometry and kinematics link
description: Optional: Recognizes and uses the 45° geometry of the fields and the perpendicular passage through point A to set up kinematic relationships.

title: Sign/direction error
description: Pitfall: Makes an error with the sign or vector direction of forces/accelerations, especially confusing the 45° orientations of E1 and E2.

title: Unit or factor mistake
description: Pitfall: Omits necessary factors (like √2) or makes algebraic errors in deriving expressions for time, coordinates, or energy.
